statement: MissionControl interprets the absolute frequency index i as a signed exponent (i − 64)/32, multiplied after base-two exponentiation by the band center (160 Hz low, 320 Hz high); all 128 indices are represented. The amplitude index a uses a base-two exponent of −8 for zero, (8a − 248)/32 for 1–15, (2a − 158)/32 for 16–31, and (a − 127)/32 for 32–127. Exponents below −7.9375 map to zero amplitude; otherwise exponentiate base two. This yields a dimensionless compatibility-decoder amplitude ratio with 1 at index 127, not the community table's numerical amplitude scale (for example, the community table places index 100 near 1).

applicability.scope: Only the compatibility model's numerical units are established, not a calibrated or physically safe amplitude. The community table and compatibility consumer use different amplitude scales; do not silently equate them.
